text: You see Rhombus.
source_text: You see Rhombus.

text: Tell me about yourself.
source_text: Tell me about yourself.

text: Can you give me some history behind the Brotherhood?
source_text: Can you give me some history behind the Brotherhood?

text: Heard any good rumors?
source_text: Heard any good rumors?

text: What can you tell me about the surrounding area?
source_text: What can you tell me about the surrounding area?

text: May I help you?
source_text: May I help you?

text: Can I ask you a few questions?
source_text: Can I ask you a few questions?

text: You don't look like much of a fighter.
source_text: You don't look like much of a fighter.

text: Uhhh?
source_text: Uhhh?

text: Yes.
source_text: Yes.

text: Insolent pup. Apologize now and you'll not be hurt.
source_text: Insolent pup. Apologize now and you'll not be hurt.

text: I was trying to make a joke. I'm very sorry.
source_text: I was trying to make a joke. I'm very sorry.

text: What, by you?
source_text: What, by you?

text: What do you want?
source_text: What do you want?

text: Can I ask a few questions?
source_text: Can I ask a few questions?

text: Just how cowardly are you?
source_text: Just how cowardly are you?

text: You are a disgrace to the Brotherhood. I will teach you manners.
source_text: You are a disgrace to the Brotherhood. I will teach you manners.

text: I will waste no more time with you.
source_text: I will waste no more time with you.

text: I am Rhombus, head of the Paladins. I train those willing to learn.
source_text: I am Rhombus, head of the Paladins. I train those willing to learn.

text: Okay, can you teach me some stuff?
source_text: Okay, can you teach me some stuff?

text: Is that it? That's your life?
source_text: Is that it? That's your life?

text: What do the Paladins do?
source_text: What do the Paladins do?

text: Stuff? I could teach you how to fight...if you had any ability. But the High Elder decreed no training of new recruits until the threat of invasion passes.
source_text: Stuff? I could teach you how to fight...if you had any ability. But the High Elder decreed no training of new recruits until the threat of invasion passes.

text: What threat?
source_text: What threat?

text: Why has he stopped the training?
source_text: Why has he stopped the training?

text: I could easily defeat you in battle.
source_text: I could easily defeat you in battle.

text: It is not my place to answer. See the High Elder if you wish.
source_text: It is not my place to answer. See the High Elder if you wish.

text: Oh come on, please?
source_text: Oh come on, please?

text: All right, fine. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: All right, fine. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: There are rumors of a strange army gathering. I will not say more.
source_text: There are rumors of a strange army gathering. I will not say more.

text: Oh, come on, pretty please?
source_text: Oh, come on, pretty please?

text: Can I ask you a few more questions though?
source_text: Can I ask you a few more questions though?

text: No.
source_text: No.

text: Oh come on, pretty please?
source_text: Oh come on, pretty please?

text: Okay. Can I ask you a few more questions though?
source_text: Okay. Can I ask you a few more questions though?

text: Yes. That is all there needs to be.
source_text: Yes. That is all there needs to be.

text: Your life sounds really empty.
source_text: Your life sounds really empty.

text: Really?
source_text: Really?

text: You do not understand what it is to be a Paladin. Too bad.
source_text: You do not understand what it is to be a Paladin. Too bad.

text: You think I could become a paladin?
source_text: You think I could become a paladin?

text: Being a knight sounds stupid.
source_text: Being a knight sounds stupid.

text: Nope, I guess not. Can you some more questions?
source_text: Nope, I guess not. Can you some more questions?

text: Possibly. When the invading army is vanquished, come back to be trained.
source_text: Possibly. When the invading army is vanquished, come back to be trained.

text: I think I'll do that, thanks.
source_text: I think I'll do that, thanks.

text: By you? I could wipe the floor with you!
source_text: By you? I could wipe the floor with you!

text: Was there anything else?
source_text: Was there anything else?

text: Yes. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Yes. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: No, thanks.
source_text: No, thanks.

text: Goodbye then.
source_text: Goodbye then.

text: It takes too long. I spend my time improving those  already trained.
source_text: It takes too long. I spend my time improving those  already trained.

text: Sounds very boring.
source_text: Sounds very boring.

text: That's it? That's your life?
source_text: That's it? That's your life?

text: Darn. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Darn. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: Ha ha ha! Let's see.
source_text: Ha ha ha! Let's see.

text: The Scribes copy the plans for the weapons, and the Knights make them. The Paladins protect the Brotherhood from harm.
source_text: The Scribes copy the plans for the weapons, and the Knights make them. The Paladins protect the Brotherhood from harm.

text: What kind of harm can there be?
source_text: What kind of harm can there be?

text: God, that sounds boring.
source_text: God, that sounds boring.

text: Many covet our technology. We have at least four attacks a week, from raiders to just people who want to steal what we have.
source_text: Many covet our technology. We have at least four attacks a week, from raiders to just people who want to steal what we have.

text: Oh. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Oh. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: Talk to Vree in the main library.
source_text: Talk to Vree in the main library.

text: I do not put stock in rumors.
source_text: I do not put stock in rumors.

text: Oh come on, just one? Please?
source_text: Oh come on, just one? Please?

text: Fine.
source_text: Fine.

text: The Hub and the Boneyard are south, mountains are east, and desolate wasteland north. Whoever goes there never returns.
source_text: The Hub and the Boneyard are south, mountains are east, and desolate wasteland north. Whoever goes there never returns.

text: Put that back now!

text: This is what we do to criminals...

text: Stop that!
source_text: Stop that!

text: No wait! I can explain!

text: Go ahead. Take your best shot.

text: Darn right, you will.

text: You lie, Initiate! This is how we deal with thieves...

text: You are either stupid or making fun of me. Either way, I will not waste my time.

source_text: I said...

text: Like I just told you...
